scientific_question: Which measured train structures are excluded by the existing Ugi program policy, and how much descriptor shift does that empirical admission induce against the unchanged full train-development reference?
nonclaims: This is a train-only empirical reference control, not a held-out model claim or proof of complete graph attainability.
Admitted measured structures and their descriptor distances are not a possible generator best-case bound.
The full frozen reference and original metric definitions are preserved; the admitted-reference subset is supplemental and may lose group balance.
Measured populations overlap the train-development reference; these are descriptive controls and carry no independent generalization estimate.
Counts refer to measured empirical products, components and families; combinatorial products do not add independent component evidence.
This audit performs no training, generation, candidate selection, routing, oracle calls or biological optimization.
